scenario: building a management-ready offline HTML presentation from a renewable-energy briefing pack, local visual assets, local data snapshots, and a local source registry
user_visible_goal: Produce a reproducible HTML deck for executive review that fits multiple viewports, stays offline, preserves citations, and can be regenerated through the formal deck builder.

skill_hypothesis.with_skill: The solver is more likely to follow a slide-building workflow that enforces viewport-fit, offline packaging, multi-input navigation, reduced-motion behavior, and deliberate visual structure instead of stopping at a static long page.
skill_hypothesis.without_skill: The solver is more likely to produce a generic or partly interactive HTML page that misses no-scroll viewport fit, wheel/touch navigation parity, or the local registry-backed citation flow.

main_tests: All required outputs exist, parse, and satisfy the declared contract.
The deck is offline-safe, browser-runnable, and contains 8 real slides with DOM-visible copy.
Keyboard, wheel, and touch navigation all move between slides without relying on document scrolling.
Each required viewport shows the active slide without internal scrolling or clipped critical regions.
The build uses the local source registry and the final citation labels and URLs match its resolved output.
guardrails: Remote fonts, scripts, stylesheets, and external fetches fail the task.
A long scrolling page, rasterized slide export, or canvas-only content cannot pass.
Changing protected inputs or bypassing the local source-registry access path cannot satisfy the request-log and checksum checks.

data_provenance.world_and_country_series: Filtered local snapshots derived from the Our World in Data energy dataset.
data_provenance.briefing_context: Locally curated executive briefing requirements shaped by IEA and IRENA public reporting.
data_provenance.source_registry: Deterministic local service backed by a checked-in source catalog.

local_oracle.tests_passed: not run locally; final acceptance was validated through E2B oracle runs

notes: The chosen with_skill set uses three final-version valid successful runs on the unchanged task checksum 9086c3a1a0933b2dbfd10cad914541a4508844c0cae7216f61bf43bd4ac2feba.
The chosen without_skill set uses three final-version valid failed runs where environment/skills was removed at runtime copy time and no other task components were changed.

Observed with_skill failures on other valid runs were near-miss execution gaps such as not preserving the three exploration previews or leaving one slide under the DOM text threshold; without_skill failures were broader workflow misses.
